capabilities: Share tasks and sections across vaults
extras: Beta software; not recommended for data requiring high protection yet. The Apple Reminders bridge is a separate open-source application.
intentEvidence: Shared tasks inside your private notes. By OpenLFCP (Open Local-First Collaboration Protocol).
problem: It addresses the need for collaborative task management across separate, private Obsidian vaults while maintaining local data privacy.
summary: A local-first collaboration plugin that allows users to share and edit tasks and headings across multiple private Obsidian vaults without uploading notes.
